title: Dose-Change End Date Schedule — Retail Pharmacy Network Benefit
content:
**Schedule rule.** For a dose-change override under the Retail Pharmacy Network Benefit, the dose-change end date is the date the fill being re-dosed would have run out under its own dosing, taken as a share of its days supply rounded down to whole days:

- for a controlled substance, the share is the network's refill fraction for controlled substances;
- for a drug that is not a controlled substance and carries a quantity limit in the member's review package (the drugs the member's Utilization Management Program places a quantity limit on), the share is the whole days supply;
- for any other drug, it is the network's refill fraction for drugs that are not controlled.

The end date falls that many whole days after the day the fill's days start: its date of service for a retail fill, or the day its home delivery days start for a shipment.

## Shares by network

| Network | Controlled substance | Not controlled, with a quantity limit in the review package | Any other drug |
|---|---|---|---|
| Northbridge Performance Network | 0.9 | 1.0 (whole days supply) | 0.8 |
| Northbridge Essential Network | 0.9 | 1.0 | 0.8 |
| Northbridge National Network | 0.85 | 1.0 | 0.75 |
| Northbridge Preferred Savings Network | 0.85 | 1.0 | 0.75 |
| Northbridge Retail90 Network | 0.85 | 1.0 | 0.75 |
| Northbridge Open Choice Network | 0.85 | 1.0 | 0.75 |

The controlled substance on these networks is oxycodone-acetaminophen.

## Worked shares (hypothetical fills whose days start on day 0)

- 30-day fill of a drug with no quantity limit on the Northbridge National Network: 30 multiplied by 0.75 is 22.5, rounded down to 22; the end date is day 22.
- 30-day fill of a drug with a quantity limit in the review package, any network: the end date is day 30.
- 10-day fill of oxycodone-acetaminophen on the Northbridge Performance Network: 10 multiplied by 0.9 is 9; the end date is day 9.
